module: Manages vehicle and trailer delivery offers in career mode (the allOffers list): adding, lookup (by location, by facility, non-expired), vehicle category labels (junkerVeh, smallVeh, largeVeh, fleetVeh, exoticVeh, empty/loaded small, medium, large trailers) with their unlock flag, and spawning an offer vehicle in the world via a util_stepHandler sequence. Also used to build the label of a vehicle task for the UI.
notes: Offer spawn: fade to black, vehicle spawn (model/config of offer.vehicle), placement on the spot offer.spawnLocation.psPath, mileage initialization (partCondition.initConditions), ignition off (setIgnitionLevel 0), ping then reading of the main part's odometer (offer.startingOdometer, -1 if not found), task creation via vehicleTasks.addVehicleTask, starting delivery mode, fade back in.
offer.spawned = true is set at the very start of spawnOffer: the offer immediately disappears from the 'unexpired' lists.
The filters getAllOfferUnexpired and getAllOfferAtFacilityUnexpired do not look at the facility's visibility/unlocking (commented code).
The psPath parameter of getAllOfferAtFacilityUnexpired is ignored.
sameLocation(a, b) is asymmetric: only the keys of a are compared (as in parcelManager).
All filtering calls first trigger triggerAllGenerators(): new offers can be generated as a side effect.
The vehicleTags table associates emptyLargeTrailer (singular, no final 's') whereas the others are plural: keep this in mind if you use the key.

onCareerActivated.desc: Hook called on career activation: stores the other delivery extensions and util_stepHandler.

makeTaskLabel.desc: Builds the translated label of an offer task: vehicleDropOff according to lookupType (repair, private home, return after repair, truck, default "bringTo"), trailerDropOff ("towTo"), or "dropOffAt" if the task has a destination; otherwise "unknown".

isVehicleTagUnlocked.desc: Indicates whether the category's unlock flag is active in career_modules_unlockFlags. An unknown category is considered unlocked.

returns.desc: Flag definition (absent for an unknown category).

getVehicleTagUnlockedSimple.desc: Unlock state of all vehicle categories.

getVehicleTagLabelSingular.desc: Translated singular label of the category (or "noCategory" if unknown).

getVehicleTagLabelPlural.desc: Translated plural label of the category (or "noCategory" if unknown).

getDefaultVehicleModifiersForUI.desc: Returns the two modifiers displayed by default for a vehicle offer: 'route' (follow the route) and 'damage', with translated icon, label and description.

returns.desc: List of {type, icon, active, label, description}.

addOffer.desc: Adds an offer to the global list.

offer.desc: Offer (id, origin, offerExpiresAt, vehicle, task, rewards…).

sameLocationOffer.desc: Compares an offer's origin with a location via sameLocation.

sameLocation.desc: Tests the equality of two locations by comparing each key of a with that of b.

getAllOfferCustomFilter.desc: Returns the offers for which filter(offer, ...) is true, after triggering the generators.

getAllOfferForLocation.desc: Offers whose origin is the given location.

getAllOfferUnexpired.desc: Non-expired offers not yet spawned (spawned false).

getAllOfferAtFacilityUnexpired.desc: Non-expired, non-spawned offers whose origin is the facility facId.

getOfferById.desc: Looks up an offer by id.

spawnOffer.desc: Spawns an offer's vehicle (see notes), registers it as a vehicle task and starts delivery mode. Logs an error and stops if the offer is not found.

fadeToBlack.desc: Fade to black around the spawn; true by default.

callback.desc: Called at the end of the step sequence.
